text.en: Atlas original mangrove teaching-model design study, docs/53. Schematic mudbank and specimens inspired by Singapore mangroves, not a survey of Sungei Buloh, not to scale. The selected directed graph has six functional nodes and six possible feeding links. Climbing crabs group several kinds, with leaf feeding and algae grazing from different accounts. Table rows enumerate seven removal choices, four inspected consumers and two tide poses. Nodes are supported if still present and reachable from an available producer through the selected links. Active links connect supported nodes; foods counts the active incoming links of the inspected node. The intact model has six present, six supported, six active links and two shown mudskipper food inputs. Removing fiddlers gives five present, five supported, four active links and one mudskipper input. Removing algae gives five present, four supported, three active links and one mudskipper input, or no shown fiddler input. High-water pose offsets water by 0.14 model units and climbing crabs by 0.16; low-water offsets are zero. These are scene offsets, not tide measurements.
text.zh: 本主题的 Atlas 原创设计研究，见 docs/53。泥岸与标本是参考新加坡红树林的示意，不是双溪布洛调查，也不按比例。选入的有向图有六个功能节点、六条可能的取食关系。攀爬蟹类合并不同种类，叶食和藻食来自不同资料。查表数据枚举七种移走选择、四个查看对象和两种潮位姿态。一个节点未被移走、且能沿选入关系从生产者到达，就标作仍有食物路径；有效连线连接这样的节点。“图内食物种类”数查看节点的有效输入。完整模型：未移走六节点、有路径六节点、六条有效线，弹涂鱼有两种输入。移走招潮蟹：五、五、四，弹涂鱼剩一种；移走藻类：五、四、三，弹涂鱼剩一种，招潮蟹则没有图内食物。高水位把水面移高 0.14、攀爬蟹类移高 0.16 模型单位；低水位位移为零。这是场景位移，不是实测潮位。

note.en: DESIGN/SIM, not measured abundance or a population forecast. Removal closes one node’s continuing supply and associated links; unsupported animal symbols remain visible. Old litter, carcasses, reproduction, movement, other food and decay rates are omitted. Functional-group links need not occur in one species, place, season or tide. Food-web links show food to consumer, never nutrient return. Equal line widths do not encode equal amounts. Tide only changes drawing pose and does not alter food calculations. Original procedural geometry and reused original Atlas illustrations; no third-party dataset, photograph or traced geometry shipped.
note.zh: 设计／模拟值，不是野外数量或种群预测。移走关闭一个节点的持续供应及相关线；没有图内食物路径的动物仍保留图标。不模拟旧落叶、尸体、繁殖、迁移、其他食物或分解速率。功能组关系未必在同一物种、地点、季节或潮时发生。箭头从食物指向消费者，不表示养分回流；同样线宽不表示同样食量。潮位只改画面姿态，不改食物计算。几何为原创程序化模型，图像复用 Atlas 原创图；未发布第三方数据集、照片或描摹几何。
